# Wiser Tools

> Independent, hands-on reviews and comparisons of managed hosting, SaaS tools, and developer services. We compare on merits, disclose affiliate relationships, and never accept payment for placement.

## Hosting comparisons
- Best Managed WordPress Hosting 2026 — https://wiser-tools.com/best-managed-wordpress-hosting : A no-hype comparison of Kinsta, Cloudways, WP Engine, and SiteGround on speed, support, pricing, and who each host is actually for, matched to the reader's situation (no single "top pick").
- Managed WordPress Hosting for Agencies — https://wiser-tools.com/managed-wordpress-hosting-for-agencies : Client-site operations — site isolation, client billing, staging, migrations, and white-label hand-off across the four hosts, matched to agency client mix.
- Managed WordPress Hosting for WooCommerce — https://wiser-tools.com/wordpress-hosting-for-woocommerce : Store-focused comparison — checkout speed under logged-in traffic, object caching, staging for product changes, matched to store type.
- Best WordPress Hosting for Small Business — https://wiser-tools.com/wordpress-hosting-for-small-business : Reliability, support, migration from GoDaddy/cPanel, and honest cost, matched to business type.
- Wiser Tools (home) — https://wiser-tools.com/ : Index of our reviews and comparisons.

## WordPress guides (no affiliate links)
- WordPress Guides (index) — https://wiser-tools.com/wordpress-guides : Index of our practical WordPress guides.
- How to Fix the WordPress White Screen of Death — https://wiser-tools.com/fix-wordpress-white-screen-of-death : Step-by-step diagnosis — surface the real error with WP_DEBUG, then rule out memory, plugins, theme and core files, in the order that actually finds the cause.
- How to Speed Up WordPress: Diagnose First — https://wiser-tools.com/how-to-speed-up-wordpress : Measure TTFB, LCP, INP and CLS first to identify whether the bottleneck is server-side, front-end, or JavaScript, then fix in order of impact.
- WordPress Caching Plugins, Compared — https://wiser-tools.com/wordpress-caching-plugins-compared : The four caching layers (opcode, page, object, CDN), which plugins handle each, and why stacking two page caches causes staleness bugs.
- WordPress PHP Workers, Explained — https://wiser-tools.com/wordpress-php-workers-explained : Why a site that is fast at ten visitors crawls at a hundred, how to estimate how many workers you need, and why more workers do not make a slow page faster.
- WordPress Backup Strategies That Actually Restore — https://wiser-tools.com/wordpress-backup-strategies-explained : The 3-2-1 rule for WordPress, backup frequency by site type, and the mistakes that make backups useless.
- Move WordPress to a New Host Without Downtime — https://wiser-tools.com/move-wordpress-to-new-host-without-downtime : Stage on the new host first, handle serialized URLs correctly, lower DNS TTL early, and avoid the email trap.

## What Wiser Tools is
Wiser Tools is an independent review publisher. Our recommendations are based on genuine product research. We may earn a commission from some partner links at no extra cost to readers; this does not affect our rankings or recommendations.

## Editorial policy
- Affiliate disclosure: commissions may be earned on sign-ups via our links, at no extra cost to readers.
- We do not publish sponsored rankings or "best of" lists padded with products we have not tested.
- Prices and program terms change; verify current details on each vendor's official site before purchasing.
